description: Bulk-write or clear permission overrides: create expands resources x actions into "resource:action" permission grants for one role, delete clears them, list shows the overrides currently set. Valid expansions: registry:approve, registry:deprecate, team:manage_rbac, team:manage_sso. Requires the team:manage_rbac permission and Enterprise tier (rbac feature).

role.description: Role the policy applies to (required for create/delete)

name: rbac_create_policy
title: Create RBAC Policy
